meta.title: PaymentState: Every Variant Carries Its Own Facts

cards.title: Each variant carries its own data
items: Authorized always has a transaction_id; Declined always has a reason (not shown — a sibling terminal variant)
There's no way to construct an Authorized state missing its transaction_id

cards.title: match must be exhaustive
items: Add a Refunded variant later, and every match without it fails to compile
The compiler becomes a checklist for every place that needs updating
